mechanism: Atorvastatin is metabolized by CYP3A4, and fluphenazine may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing atorvastatin levels; additionally, both drugs can cause myopathy/rhabdomyolysis risk.
action: Monitor for statin-related myopathy symptoms (muscle pain, weakness); consider measuring CK levels; dose adjustment of atorvastatin may be necessary if symptoms emerge.
